items.title: Bournemouth close in on £11.1m Juanlu
items.summary: Bournemouth are finalising an £11.1m move for Sevilla right-back Juanlu as new manager Marco Rose's squad nears completion.

items.title: 2,000km, eight countries, 29 days - the fastest runner to cross the Alps
items.summary: Ultra-runner Sophie Woods runs 2,000km across eight countries in only 29 days to break the record for completing the Via Alpina - one of the world's toughest endurance challenges.
items.whyItMatters: Running and athletics widen the page beyond match coverage into performance and training stories.
